Conversation, family & daily routines

get up verb

also rise, get out of bed

classical

surgō, surgere, surrēxī, surrēctum

verb, third conjugation

get up or rise

Examples

  • Surge, Theodōre.

    Get up, Theo.composed

  • Ē lectō surgāmus.

    Let’s get out of bed.composed

  • surge et ambulā

    get up and walk: Dad, lifting the sleeping boy out of bed (Mt 9, 5, in jest)Libellus I, Iter in Lūsitāniam

See also wake up, bed.

SourcesLewis & Short: surgo · Dickinson: Latin Core Vocabulary

Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.

The example sentences marked “composed” are ours.
